THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT)) ACT NO. 28 OF 1964 NOTICE

UNDER SECTION 7 My Ref. : MOR/LAN/01/F1/200. I, hereby give public notice, under Sub-section 1 of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act. No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land for a public purpose.

Description of the Land to be acquired: The land described in the Surveyor General’s Plan No. Cadastral Map No. 520217 dated 20.02.2015 having an total extent of 0.3935 Hectare situated in the village of Egodauyana in the Grama Niladari Divisions of 556 Egodauyana North in the limits of Moratuwa Divisional Secretary’s Divisions, Colombo District in the Western Province.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land, are hereby required to appear personally or through their agents, duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat, Moratuwa on the 21st October, 2015 at 9.30 a.m. and all hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 12th October, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation, and the details of the compensation of such amount.
All deeds and relevant documents in support of claim should be provided at the inquiry.
K. C. NIROSHAN, Divisional Secretary, Moratuwa. Divisional Secretariat, Moratuwa, 03rd July, 2015.
